subject: Next steps for ThreeCloud marketplace onboarding (PO + evidence)
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@threecloud.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@threecloud.io
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding - procurement checklist and PO

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — ThreeCloud is excited about listing on Redwood in the AWS and Azure marketplaces. Procurement asked me to gather the necessary paperwork so we can issue a PO and confirm the go-live window. Can you confirm: 1) required vendor onboarding form, 2) any SOC2 or compliance artifacts we need to share, and 3) preferred PO recipient/email for route-to-pay?

We can turn around a PO within a few days once we have the required fields and the invoice remit. Also attaching the procurement template the team typically uses.

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Head of Partnerships | ThreeCloud Inc.
Attach: threecloud_initial_po.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@threecloud.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - procurement checklist and PO

Hi Alex — great to hear. Short answers below and a quick next-steps list.

Required items from ThreeCloud for marketplace vendor activation:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (fields: legal entity name, EIN/VAT, remit address, invoice email, contact + contact role) — see attached PDF stub.
- W9 or W8-BEN (depending on entity) for accounting.
- SOC 2 summary or attestation (high-level PDF is fine; we only need a summary to satisfy initial review).
- Signed MSA or acknowledgement of Redwood marketplace terms (DocuSign link will be sent when PO is received).

Our preferred PO routing: vendor-payments@redwood.ai (AP team) or you can send PO to me and I’ll route it. For faster processing, include a contact + invoice remit email and mark vendor as "marketplace listing" on the PO.

Estimated timeline once we have completed docs and PO: 3–5 business days for vendor intake + marketplace listing slot depending on the cloud provider (AWS tends to be fastest, Azure/GCP vary a bit).

Attachments: threecloud_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, threecloud_soc2_summary.pdf

Next steps (action owners):
- Alex: return completed onboarding form + SOC2 summary + PO (attach to this thread).
- Ben (CCed): confirm tax/finance routing and whether Net30 is OK or we need a different payment term.
- Vanessa: finalize marketplace slot and go-live window once PO confirmed.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Business Development Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@threecloud.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - procurement checklist and PO

Thanks — quick finance check: we can accept PO to vendor-payments@redwood.ai. Standard terms are Net30 unless ThreeCloud requests upfront prepay for a dedicated activation slot (rare).

One ask from accounting: please ensure PO includes the vendor remit email and legal name exactly as on the W9/W8. If you have a tax form ready, upload it alongside the PO to speed validation.

I flagged the HubSpot deal for billing intake: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/THREE-4721

Ben
Sr. Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@threecloud.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - procurement checklist and PO

Thanks all — attached the completed onboarding form and our SOC2 summary. We will route the PO from our procurement system to vendor-payments@redwood.ai by EOD today.

Questions:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a fully executed MSA before activating the listing, or if an acknowledgement + PO is sufficient for initial public listing?
- If we can get a target go-live after PO, what dates are you seeing for AWS vs Azure?

Regards,
Alex
Attach: threecloud_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, threecloud_soc2_summary.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@threecloud.io>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - procurement checklist and PO

Alex — great, thanks for sending the docs. Short responses:

- MSA: for marketplace activation we typically accept a PO + signed marketplace terms acknowledgement to start the listing process. A fully executed MSA is required before billing goes live, but we can provision the listing slot with the acknowledgement so you can be discoverable.

- Estimated go-live windows once PO + acknowledgement received:
  * AWS: 2–4 business days (slot permitting)
  * Azure: 4–7 business days (catalog review & metadata checks)
  * GCP: 5–9 business days (depends on filesystem/catalog sync)

Workflow for PO receipt (internal routing):
1) PO arrives to vendor-payments@redwood.ai (or forwarded to me).
2) Ben validates tax and remit fields.
3) AP issues invoice record and triggers acknowledgement/DocuSign envelope for marketplace terms.
4) Listing team (me) schedules slot and sends any metadata checklist.

I’ll create the DocuSign envelope for the marketplace acknowledgement as soon as Ben confirms the PO format. Putting DocuSign link in the HubSpot deal and will ping you when envelope is sent: https://www.docusign.com/containers/embeddedSigning?docId=abc123-threecloud

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
Attach: redwood_msa_v1_signed_stub.docx (docx stub)
